reconstruction_notes.en: Original7m-wide representative shore-platform patch: a broad low gently seaward-sloping abrasion bench remains continuous with a retreated rear cliff face, with restrained shallow weathered pans and one joint. Clear cropped bedrock sides and back, no high waterfall stair, tiny isolated stone or sea-stack substitution. NPS coastal context and primary GSA shore-platform/cliff study consulted. Weathering and erosion contributions vary; not a claim that waves alone universally cut platforms. Nominal dimensions, local slope, palette and layout are art choices, not a mapped ancient site, exact tide level or fluid simulation.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创7米宽代表海岸岩台片区：宽低、向海缓倾的磨蚀岩台与后缘退缩岩面连续，以少量浅蚀洼及一条节理提示结构。岩层侧缘和后缘为明确裁切，不做高瀑布台阶、小独石或海蚀柱替代。已查NPS海岸背景及GSA岩台与海崖实地研究。风化与侵蚀贡献各异，不主张所有岩台均仅由波浪直接切成。名义尺寸、局部坡度、配色及布局为美术设定，不是古地点测绘、精确潮位或流体模拟。
